item.description:
This release brings three notable changes: * macOS 27 added damping to vertical three-finger gestures (i.e. swiping up to Mission Control or down to App Expose), which means that the configured curve in FasterSwiper wouldn't be followed very well. v1.7.0 adds a new feature that attempts to compensate for this damping, bringing the actual animation closer to the intended curve. It's not perfect, but should be a major improvement. It's on by default, but you can toggle it off in Settings if it doesn't work well for you. * The occurrence of errant "black slide animations," typically caused by long instant travels between spaces (e.g. jumping from space 1 to space 10), should be largely eliminated (fixes #6). * FasterSwiper now periodically checks for updates by default. You can toggle this feature off in Settings.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mgbowen/FasterSwiper/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0
